{{Infobox/Generic |image=Chocolate Factory.png }} The '''Chocolate Factory''' is a spiritual successor to [[Cookie Clicker]] found within [[Calendar and Events]] or accessed via the {{gray|/factory}}, {{gray|/cf}} and {{gray|/chocolatefactory}} commands. == Mechanics == The '''Chocolate Factory''' is a minigame that consists of clicking to gain {{choc}} and then spending it on upgrades and employees, as well as some items from the Chocolate Shop. Players can collect lifetime chocolate in order to unlock milestones and upgrade the level of their chocolate factory, allowing it to produce more '''Chocolate'''. == Clicking == Players can click the '''Chocolate Factory''' icon in the UI to gain 1 {{choc}}. This must be done at least 50 times to gain {{choc|50}}, which can be used to hire {{NPCSprite|Rabbit Bro}}, in order to unlock automatic '''Chocolate''' production. Purchasing the Hand Baked Chocolate upgrade will increase the amount of '''Chocolate''' gained from clicking up to a maximum of 10 '''Chocolate''' at level 10. === Stray Rabbits === '''Stray Rabbits''' have a {{Green|20%}} chance every {{Green|30}} seconds to appear in the '''Chocolate Factory''' UI, staying for 15s, and will give {{Chocolate}} when clicked. Only rabbits the player has already found can appear (the exception being Fish the Rabbit and Golden Rabbits) and will give a different amount of {{Chocolate}} based on the rabbit's rarity and the player's current CpS. A '''Stray Rabbit''' is guaranteed to appear at most {{Green|30}} seconds after a [[Chocolate Egg]] has been collected (not including {{Gold|Side Dish}}). The first stray after collecting an egg has a chance to be a {{Gold|Golden Rabbit}} ({{Green|10%}} by default, or {{Green|20%}} with {{Pink|Omega}}). These do not apply if the player swaps lobbies between collecting the egg and attempting to roll for a stray. Zeta Rabbit ({{Mythic}}) reduces the cost of your employee upgrades by {{Green|1%}}. It is unlocked by reaching {{Chocolate|250M}} spent in the Chocolate Shop. == Upgrades == Aside from employees, there are 5 total upgrades that each work in a unique way to help players max the '''Chocolate Factory'''. Same as employees, all upgrades are lost upon prestige. === Rabbit Barn === [[File:Oak Fence.png|thumb|100px]] The Rabbit Barn, unlocked at Chocolate Factory 1, determines the maximum number of unique [[Chocolate Rabbits]] the player can hold in their Hoppity's Collection. If the maximum number of '''Chocolate Rabbits''' is reached, then any subsequently obtained rabbits will be crushed. This is the only upgrade that is not reset upon upgrading the Chocolate Factory. Level 1 is unlocked by default, and the cost to unlock level 2 is {{Chocolate|5,000}}. The cost for subsequent levels can be calculated using the following formula, where L is the desired rabbit barn level. \lfloor 5000 \times 1.05^{L - 1} \rceil === Hand-Baked Chocolate === [[File:Cookie.png|thumb|100px]] The Hand-Baked Chocolate upgrade, unlocked at Chocolate Factory 1, determines how much {{choc}} is earnt by clicking. It can be upgraded to a maximum level of 10, giving +{{choc|1}} per click per level for a maximum of {{choc|10}} per click. This is the only way to increase the amount of '''Chocolate''' earnt per click in the '''Chocolate Factory'''. The cost of each level can be calculated using the formula 500 \times (L - 1), where L is the Hand-Baked Chocolate level. The cumulative cost at level 10 is {{Chocolate|22,500}}. The cost is irrespective of the player's Chocolate Factory level. === Time Tower === [[File:Clock.png|thumb|100px]] The Time Tower, unlocked at Chocolate Factory 2, allows the player to temporarily boost '''Chocolate''' production. The Time Tower slowly builds up to 3 charges, each over an 8 hour period, which can then be activated one at a time to add a multiplier to '''Chocolate''' production for 1 hour. The '''Chocolate Rabbit''' {{pink|Einstein}} decreases the charge time of the Time Tower to just 7h per charge or 21h for a full charge and {{pink|Mu}} increases production by +0.7x {{choc}}. The multiplier is equal to \frac {1} {10} times the level of the Time Tower, starting at +0.1x (+0.8x with {{pink|Mu}}) at level 1 up to a maximum of +1.5x (+2.2x with {{pink|Mu}}) at level 15. Level 1 is unlocked by default. Eggs claimed this way can contain any unlocked [[Chocolate Rabbits|Chocolate Rabbit]], including Residents. Additionally, each Hitman Egg claimed can spawn a [[Chocolate Factory#Stray Rabbits|Golden Rabbit]] in the Chocolate Factory roughly {{Green|30}} seconds after the next time the Chocolate Factory is opened. Each egg takes up a slot in Hitman's storage. Once an egg is claimed, the slot goes on a cooldown of {{Green|20 minutes}} * AmountOfSlotsOnCooldown * (1 - ({{Attr|Hitman Cooldown}} level * 0.025)), during which it cannot be reused to store another egg. Only one slot's cooldown is active at a time, so if the player had {{Green|2}} slots on cooldown, the first one will be available after {{Green|20 minutes}}, and the second after {{Green|40 minutes}}. Slots can be unlocked for a price in {{C}}, increasing with each slot purchased. The total cost of purchasing all {{Green|28}} slots is {{C|292111000}}.
